minutes.headline: Planning Board approved AT&T tower antennas and continued the Mass Ave three-family and warrant article hearings to April 9.
minutes.summary: The board closed and approved an AT&T modification on Chase Road, then heard a site plan for a three-family dwelling at 654 Mass Ave, which was continued with requests for traffic, lighting and community statements. It then worked through proposed May Town Meeting zoning articles against the building commissioner's memo, including chickens, tow yards, accessory dwellings and marijuana provisions, and continued that hearing. The meeting ended with a roll call to enter executive session on solar litigation.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board closed the AT&T hearing at Chase Road and approved a modification adding three antennas, with a waiver on the supplemental information deadline.
The hearing on a three-family dwelling at 654 Mass Ave was continued to April 9; the vote was not audible in the captions.
The applicant was told April 3 at 4 p.m. is the deadline for supplemental information on the Mass Ave plan.

On May Town Meeting zoning articles, the board agreed to research a vehicle storage yard use but not add a definition now, and set accessory dwellings to require single ownership with one unit owner-occupied.
The warrant articles hearing was continued to April 9, and the planning director is to consult town counsel and return language at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: The warrant articles, covering chickens, tow yards, accessory dwellings and marijuana provisions, are zoning changes residents will be asked to vote on at May Town Meeting.
The 654 Mass Ave plan is still open, so neighbors' concerns about drainage, traffic and lighting can still be raised before the board decides.
watch_next: April 9: continued hearings on the 654 Mass Ave site plan and the May Town Meeting warrant articles.
April 3 at 4 p.m.: deadline for the 654 Mass Ave applicant's supplemental information.
